nodes.q: Which cloud accounting platform is best?
nodes.a: There is no single best platform — it depends on your industry, workflows, integrations, and team. Xero is popular for its app ecosystem, QuickBooks for smaller businesses, MYOB for some Australian payroll scenarios. The matched specialist recommends based on your specific needs, not a default.

Xero is popular for its app ecosystem, QuickBooks for smaller businesses, MYOB for some Australian payroll scenarios. The matched specialist recommends based on your specific needs, not a default.

nodes.q: Can you migrate my data without losing history?
nodes.a: Yes — our matched specialists manage migrations cleanly, bringing across opening balances, customer/supplier records, and historical transactions where needed, then reconciling so the new system is correct from day one. Some historical detail may be summarised in very old periods, but the current position is preserved accurately.

nodes.q: How much does cloud accounting setup cost?
nodes.a: A straightforward setup may be $500–$2,000; a full migration with data transfer, automation, and training can be $2,000–$6,000 depending on complexity. The matched specialist gives you a clear quote after reviewing your situation. The matching itself is free.
